requirements.description: Payment SSI index exposes exactly the four governed MT2 messages.
Every message has separately selectable OPERATIONAL and QA_TEST_ONLY scenarios; operational rows sort before QA rows.
Input ownership, settlement roles, options and expected MT output match the governed MT2 MRG evidence.
Plain messages use swift.cbprplus.04 and cover messages use swift.cbprplus.cov.04 for pacs.009.001.08.
Each NVR records its validation owner and actual outcome; unexecuted upstream validation remains NOT_EVALUATED or NOT_EXECUTED.
Every eligible currency multiplied by every eligible SSI counterparty is resolved for all four messages, with explicit governed exclusions.
Missing, inactive, mismatched, ambiguous and boundary fixtures fail closed without payload or confirmed resolution.
Resolve displays an accessible spinner; dependency changes synchronously clear stale selections; Cancel returns to the selected message scenario list.
OAS drives page parameters and the generic UI; the UI contains no message-specific business decision table.
Existing MT3, MT4 and MT7 resolution and UI acceptance suites remain green.
npm run verify passes on the acceptance revision.
npm audit reports zero Critical and zero High vulnerabilities.
Current-worktree Sonar has Blocker, Critical and Major equal to zero and Minor below 20.
